newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK HK Ind makes bid for Island Dyeing.
newsitem.headline: SHK HK Ind makes bid for Island Dyeing.

text.p: SHK Hong Kong Industries Ltd and First Pacific Davies Ltd (FPD) have launched a formal bid for all outstanding shares in Island Dyeing and Printing Co Ltd, the companies said in a joint announcement on Wednesday.
Sun Hung Kai Industries, along with First Pacific Davies, a subsidiary of listed First Pacific Co Ltd, are offering HK$7.60 per share for all of the Island Dyeing shares they do not already own.

The sale price of HK$7.60 per share represents a 23.38 percent premium to the audited consolidated net asset value per share of HK$6.16 as of March 30, 1996 and values Island Dyeing at HK$501.6 million.
Trading in SHK Industries and Island Dyeing, suspended on September 25, resumed on Wednesday.
SHK Industries and parties acting in concert with it have acquired a total of 73.79 percent of the issued capital of the company.
Island Dying fell HK$0.05 to HK$7.65 and SHK Industries was unchanged at $0.495 on Wednesday morning.
